messages:
Maya: CI blocked for release/v2.3.1 — SAST flagged infra/keystore_client.go as containing a hard-coded keystore usage. blocking-pr #4521 :grimacing:
Ben: Scanner log shows a decrypt failure before heuristic kicked in. error: `kms_decrypt PERMISSION_DENIED`
Ben: pipeline snippet:
```
time=2026-03-20T17:02:13Z component=sast-scanner msg=\"kms_decrypt failed\" err=\"PermissionDenied\"
```
sec-bot: Found audit entry:
{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T17:02:13Z","principal":"serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com","action":"cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt","resource":"projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/keystore","status":"PERMISSION_DENIED"}
Liu: We rotated keys last night and narrowed ACLs to deployer-sa + keystore-ops; scanner-sa was omitted by mistake.
Frank: Don't create wide suppressions. Short-term: ephemeral decrypt grant for scanner-sa, re-run SAST, capture evidence, then revoke.
Maya: Agreed. DevOps, can you grant ephemeral access for 30m and re-run CI?
DevOps-Bot: Command executed: `grant --sa=scanner-sa --key=keystore --role=roles/cloudkms.decrypter --expiry=30m`. Expires at 2026-03-20T17:32:13Z. :white_check_mark:
Ben: Re-run done. SAST finished — keystore usage is legitimate (env var + client lib). Marked FP. Evidence attached to SEC-917 (artifact, decrypted output, logs).
Alexa: I'll create a scoped suppression for rule=SAST-KEystore-001, scope=repo:infra/path:infra/keystore_client.go, owner=infra-team, ttl=7d, with attached evidence.
Liu: I'll update the keystore rotation runbook to add an allowlist update step and a CI preflight that verifies scanner-sa is in key ACLs before rotation.
Frank: Post-mortem items: root cause (rotation checklist gap), short-term (ephemeral grant + scoped suppression), long-term (automation + audit alert if scanners lose decrypt perms). I'll schedule a 24h sync and own the alert rule.
Maya: Action items: Ben attach bundle (done), DevOps verify revocation at expiry, Liu update playbook, Alexa create suppression, Frank schedule post-mortem.
DevOps-Bot: Ephemeral grant revoked at 2026-03-20T17:32:13Z — revocation verified.
